rationale: Motor-vehicle collision resulting in severe damage to the policyholder's vehicle and bodily injury to the driver.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan was rear-ended on Route 9 at a red light by a vehicle traveling ~35 mph with no braking. The policyholder's vehicle is totaled with the trunk crushed into the back seat. The claimant sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. Other driver's insurance information is documented on the police report.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by another vehicle traveling at approximately 35 mph with no braking; entire trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.injury_party: claimant sustained whiplash and sprained wrist
